peopleAlsoAsk.question: How thick is reefer container insulation?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet:
Reefer container insulation thickness

 For polyurethane foam insulation, the thickness typically ranges from 60mm to 100mm: Chilled cargo (0°C to +5°C): 60–75mm. Frozen cargo (-18°C to -25°C): 75–90mm. Deep-frozen cargo (-25°C to -35°C): 90–100mm.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: Does a shipping container need to be insulated?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: A metal shipping container needs quality insulation because of the conductive nature of its composition. A steel shipping container will experience temperature fluctuations, exaggerated noise, and damaging condensation.
